items.text: We cannot overcome this pandemic without the sound advice from our medical professionals on the ground fighting COVID every day. To overcome this battle we need an all hands on deck approach. It is past the time for action, we are in this fight together. https://t.co/YoPM1DiiIF https://t.co/W7EssRnxaf
On Kauaʻi, I met with @USGS and @USFWS who are critical partners to preserving the health of Hanalei river and all those who inhabit this special area 🦆🐟🦬👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 https://t.co/pmdotkk4rN

Since 2011, anti-abortion lawmakers have pushed 500+ laws through state legislatures to erode access to abortion. Last year, the U.S. House passed the Woman’s Health Protection Act to end this ongoing attack on reproductive rights.

It’s time for the Senate to follow our lead. https://t.co/995nUb0ZRR

We have a duty to care for our veterans and military families. Today, I will continue my long-term commitment to our armed forces by voting for the Honoring our PACT Act, which will provide healthcare for 3.5 million toxic-exposed veterans. (1/2)

The PACT Act includes a provision in honor of the late Hawaiʻi Congressman Mark Takai. The Mark Takai Atomic Veterans Healthcare Parity Act permits veterans who participated in the cleanup of Enewetak Atoll to receive service-connected compensation benefits & medical care. (2/2)

Great news, Maui! We just approved $1,000,000 through the U.S. House to help finance the Hana Health Rehabilitation and Support Center.

I called Executive Director Cheryl Vasconcellos to congratulate her and thank Hana Health for all they do for our rural Hana community. https://t.co/miHFVw7hzs

Everyone deserves the right to access birth control. Today, we honor 50 years of #EisenstadtvBaird50 by calling for stronger protection of #reprorights through measures like the Women’s Health Protection Act. https://t.co/QQ9Lch4oUh

Great to talk story with middle and high school students during the Youth Forum Kauaʻi Planning and Action Alliance.

Listening to our impassioned youth and their concerns regarding the economy, health and educational opportunity gives me great optimism for the future of Kauaʻi. https://t.co/ggbXr4L5ic

Mahalo Mālama Hulēʻia for sharing the incredible progress you’ve made on the Alakoko fishpond restoration project. Thriving ecosystems and native plants are crucial for the health of our loko iʻa. https://t.co/xnbPXM8uHf

Reducing our fossil fuel dependence isn’t just good for the environment, its good for business. Prioritizing sustainable aviation improves community health, unlocks new economic opportunities & creates jobs.

My remarks at the @transportdems aviation hearing on climate change. https://t.co/XNCJpG4jrg
The next World Health Assembly begins on May 22nd. Now is the time to invite Taiwan as an observer to lend its expertise. #TaiwanCanHelp

Starting tomorrow, we’ll have a new nationwide number to call for suicide prevention, mental health and substance use crises: 988. Call or text to be connected to trained crisis counselors who can help you or someone you know. #988Lifeline Mahalo @samhsagov https://t.co/FxJuDHfoSa

I joined @AARPHawaii State Director Kealiʻi Lopez & Advocacy Associate Director Audrey Suga-Nakagawa to discuss the #InflationReductionAct’s transformative health care benefits for our kūpuna. 

Finally, Medicare will be able to negotiate Rx prices & insulin will stay below $35! https://t.co/N8xFuH8JE8

On World Suicide Prevention Day, it is important to remember you can always reach out and find help. 988 is a nationwide mental health crisis and suicide prevention number. There is help, there is hope. 
#WorldSuicidePreventionDay  #Stay

Today I’m at the @WhiteHouse with Sen Schatz celebrating the #InflationReductionAct, which lowers costs of health care & prescription drugs for working families, & will fight climate change. I’m proud to have voted for this legislation, which will benefit communities across HI 🤙🏽 https://t.co/APpw8O5Q8G

Full Health Care for the National Guard

Total Annual Cost: $719M
Total National Guard Members: 400K

Total Annual Cost: $1787.50
Total Monthly Cost: $148.95

It is unacceptable that 15% of our National Guard service members do not have healthcare. 
 
Congress must do better.

1,541 women in Hawaiʻi are diagnosed with breast cancer annually.
When breast cancer is detected early there is a 93% survival rate in the first five years, but insurance companies are not required to cover these diagnoses the same way screenings are covered.

This is why I signed onto the Access to Breast Cancer Act, which will make diagnostic tests more affordable by eliminating copays and additional out-of-pocket expenses.

For screening services, visit: https://t.co/0yZ74jyDFP

For my full release, visit: https://t.co/fNCUrMphJ8

The long term health impacts of the Red Hill fuel contamination cannot be understated.

Today, @RepCase, myself and our senior staff met with leaders of the @DoD_DHA for a Red Hill Health Response Update. https://t.co/zPsDV9Qpr8

Starting Jan. 3rd 2023, the DHA will open a Red Hill Hawai‘i Clinic at BHC Makalapa for service members and their families to evaluate health effects from the Red Hill contamination.

We must do everything to protect our ‘ohana, both military and civilian on the island of Oʻahu.

Proud to stand with my bipartisan colleagues & @katiecouric be a co-sponsor of the #FindItEarlyAct which would mandate all insurance providers to cover additional screenings including diagnostic mammograms, breast ultrasounds, and breast MRIs, with no cost-sharing. https://t.co/hk8AppDrsd

Grateful to @SenMikeLee for his persistence & unwavering commitment to Lt. Ridge Alkonis & his family. 

It is unfathomable that the family of a honorable U.S. servicemember would have their pay, healthcare & benefits terminated over the holidays. 

This is the power of Congress. https://t.co/3nOM8m40w3

Excited to announce that the Molokai Community Health Center has been selected as a recipient for FY23 Community Project Funding in the amount of $1,664,000. FQHC’s are critical to rural community healthcare and I am grateful for all they do for our Molokaʻi families. https://t.co/ZPM5Axim35
